messages:
Priya: Quick question for SDK maintainers — the ruby client defaults for retries/backoff seem different from js/go. Is that intentional or a recent drift after the transport refactor?
Ben: Which defaults specifically? max_retries or backoff math?
Priya: max_retries is 3 in ruby but 5 in go, and ruby uses linear backoff + fixed jitter while go uses exponential+full jitter. Seen a couple of prod spikes where ruby gave up earlier.
Omar: That sounds like an unintentional drift. The transport refactor extracted retry logic into a tiny adapter and I think we accidentally lost exponential in the ruby adapter.
Maya: cc @Ben — we should make retry policy symmetric across SDKs unless there's a good perf reason. Can you open a compatibility PR?
Ben: Will do. Proposal: make defaults align to library-wide policy: max_retries=5, base=100ms, multiplier=2.0, jitter=0.5 (full jitter). Add opt-in for linear mode for users with strict pacing needs.
Priya: Sounds good. Also one behavioral nit: when streaming reconnect happens, ruby currently replays the whole request and that can double-charge some server-side accounting. We should recommend idempotency_key header for non-chat endpoints.
Omar: Good call. For streaming (chat/completions) we can't always be idempotent, but for embedding/rerank we can use idempotency keys. Add small doc in sampleapp and a helper in SDK to auto-generate v4 UUID idempotency header when user enables safe_retries.
Ben: I'll include a helper method `client.with_safe_retries { ... }` that sets Idempotency-Key and adjusts retry semantics. Will add unit tests and a tiny integration to sampleapp.
ci-bot: Created PR devex/sdk-ruby#387: "align retry defaults with platform policy + safe_retries helper". Pipeline: unit ok, integration flaky on mac ARM runner.
Maya: For the changelog, mark as 'fix: align retry defaults' and 'feat: safe_retries helper (opt-in)'. No breaking change.
Priya: Nice. One more ask — add a small doc note about cost implications when replaying requests on reconnect (we got a surprised customer billing ticket last week).
Ben: Will add that to the SDK README and sampleapp quickstart. Targeting patch release v1.5.0 (semver minor because of new helper).
Omar: After merge, let's open issues to audit other community SDKs for replay vs retry behavior on streaming endpoints. Priya, can you file that?
Priya: Yup filing now. Thanks all.
Ben: PR merged after mac arm fix. Released v1.5.0. :shipit:
Maya: Great, and opened cross-sdk audit issue #412.
